text: Added an llms.txt file, a plain-text map of the site for AI models. It starts an experiment: we watch our server logs to see which AI crawlers ever ask for it.
First article published: a fact-check of the top answers to "Does Google penalize AI content?" The editor changed nothing in the AI draft and wrote his own section.
Homepage rebuilt with a start-here path and section guide, and the editor got an author page. Empty sections are kept out of search until they have content.
New design, chosen by the editor from three AI-made mockups. The Lab Notebook gets its own section.
Fact-checking pipeline added. Claims now need a source before they get a sentence.
Site launched. Built and deployed by AI, approved by a human.
